Treatment summary
Patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred during a lane change, reporting low back pain and stiffness.
Diagnosis was lumbar strain. Over the course of care, the patient completed 25 visits, which is somewhat longer than typically
expected for a strain of this type, and progress was gradual with fluctuating symptoms. Examination findings included paraspinal
muscle tenderness and reduced lumbar range of motion, which are consistent with the reported injury. Other testing, including
neurological screening and straight leg raise, was within normal limits. No prior injury involving the same region of the back is
known to this provider. Billing records reviewed for this episode show no duplicate or repeated charges for the same services. At
this time, it is not yet clear to what extent the presenting back complaints are attributable to this collision, and further records
would be needed to make that determination. Patient was discharged from active care with a home exercise program and advised
to follow up as needed.
</page>
